notes.title: New Feature Added - Gameplay Progression
notes.content:
Thanks to the Steam community for suggesting that we add progression to the gameplay --- Done!

The game now starts with many options LOCKED. You have to achieve PROFIT DAYS to unlock the options.  A PROFIT DAY is one where your REVENUE is more than your EXPENSES.

For example, after 3 PROFIT DAYS you will unlock the Business District on the MARKET screen, providing you another location in the city where you can sell your products.

There are 20 game options that you can unlock, requiring a total of 60 PROFIT DAYS to unlock all. There are also 5 ACHIEVEMENTS you can earn along the way.

We hope you like this new feature!  

Note that if you have SAVED FILES created prior to this update, you can RESUME them ok, but some of the options will become LOCKED if you have not already achieved the required number of PROFIT DAYS.
